original_claims.text_verbatim: **光致 Fe–Nα 伸长 ≈ −9.2 eV/Å，光致 Nα–Nβ 缩短 ≈ +8.0 eV/Å**，三根一致。
GS 与追踪激发态曲线在 r=3.20 Å 处仍有 ≈1.16 eV 的垂直间隙未完全闭合
Fe–Nα 方向的追踪激发态绝对能量单调下降 0.70 eV

actual_question: 对已固定原子序/几何的孤立18原子模型，原件实际给的是哪一种坐标方向导数、总能/能隙目标量？规范与参考纠正后哪些方向和路径断言仍成立？
distinction_from_original: 不把局部梯度或采样能量走势升级为实际机制、通量或排除竞争通道。分别审查坐标映射、ES总量、ES-GS差量、同几何垂直隙、不同几何能高和单调性。

dependency_mapping_semantics.support_sets: Outer lists are alternative sufficient supports (OR); every group in an inner list is required (AND); every source in a source_group is required (AND).
dependency_mapping_semantics.group_result_scope: Group recomputation records must carry only this group sources/locators and scoped result quantities. A whole-case receipt may be linked as execution provenance but must not inject all source dependencies into every group.
dependency_mapping_semantics.provenance_boundary: Historical report/script snapshots remain read and cited evidence of what was reported/implemented. Changes may require historical-attribution review; they do not withdraw independently recomputed physical numbers.
dependency_mapping_semantics.negative_knowledge_boundary: The normalization algebra refutes the stated Wilson-B convention without the old script. Exact attribution that the old program used this formula requires the historical script, separately from corrected numeric derivative.
dependency_mapping_semantics.unknown_boundary: Unresolved branch records express the bounded absence of a connecting inference, not a positive physical impossibility claim.
dependency_mapping_semantics.granularity: Current manifests are file-version scoped. Changing FC gs engrad legitimately dirties the FC-reference group; changing a root1 engrad does not. Segment-field dependency refinement is deferred.
